{{Quote|But also, in taking off, we strafed the marina where the recreational water vessels of the city's wealthy-and other people, including the wealthy of the city of Hullis and the officers of Victory Base there-were docked..|Kell Tainer after a mission|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
'''Fellon's marina''' was a marina located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fellon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was strafed by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] flown by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Wraith Squadron]], who at that time were pretending to be the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]. The attack caused millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in damages as estimated by Wraith pilot [[Kell Tainer]].<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist" />
